statement: Knight's high-cycle argument is sign-free, so it mirrors onto the Juggler's side of the linear form, and Catalan supplies the complete list of its escapes. WHAT KNIGHT USES. knight-2026-collatz-high-cycles proves no integer high cycle exists from three ingredients only: the reverse of an aperiodic upper Christoffel word v_h is a rotation of it (Cohn 1972), so f(v_h) and f(v_h^R) lie in one cycle; the split v_h = 1 u 0 and v_h^R = 0 u 1 (Berstel et al); and the gap 2^k - 3^x being ODD with |gap| > 1, whence 3 f(v_h) - f(v_h^R) + 1 = 2^(k-1)/(2^k - 3^x) cannot be an integer. NONE OF THE THREE USES THE SIGN OF THE GAP. Verified here: the identity holds for every aperiodic (k,x) on BOTH sides, contracting 2^k > 3^x and expanding 2^k < 3^x, for x <= 60; the apparent failures are exactly the periodic words gcd(k,x) > 1, which Knight excludes and whose aperiodic cores he reduces to. THE MIRROR. The expanding sign 2^k < 3^x is the Juggler's and the negative Collatz cycles' (neg_cycle_expanding, J-juggler-cycle-words-are-collatz-negative-cycle-words). There the same contradiction excludes the Christoffel word's rational cycle from being integral at every aperiodic (k,x) with |gap| > 1. The escapes are |gap| = 1, and by Catalan proved by Mihailescu (the row J-lemma-eight-floor-is-tight-at-every-known-cycle records the complete list (x,k) = (0,1),(1,1),(1,2),(2,3)) the expanding side keeps exactly (1,1) and (3,2), whose Christoffel words give f = -1 and f = -5. BOTH ARE REAL CYCLES, so the mirror is consistent and tight: it kills every expanding Christoffel high cycle except the two that exist. This upgrades the Mihailescu gap observation from an extreme case closed cheaply to the completeness of Knight's exception list. IT IS THE LABORATORY'S OWN WORD. Knight's v_h is LITERALLY the ceiling mechanical word of J-cycle-cubic-band-order -- identical strings for every coprime (L,o) with L <= 18 -- so the word a height-bounded Juggler cycle must carry (M < m^3, which forces gcd(L,o) = 1 and the ceiling mechanical word) is exactly the word Knight's argument addresses. WHAT THIS DOES NOT SAY, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE POINT. It excludes the NEGATIVE COLLATZ REALIZATION of that word. It excludes no Juggler cycle: the laboratory's bridge is word-level, and a shared word shape does not transport a realization, which is the standing content of J-the-missing-juggler-floor-is-worth-a-quarter-at-length-22. Nor does it contradict J-christoffel-one-parameter, which refuted CONCENTRATION of leftover cells on the Christoffel necklace and explicitly left cycle-only near-Christoffel rigidity open. Consistency check: -17 sits at (k,x) = (11,7) but is NOT the high cycle there, the Christoffel word at (11,7) giving the non-integer -3767/139, so the mirror kills the high cycle at that length while -17 survives as a different rotation class. No floor is raised, no period bound moves, and Paper A is unchanged.

The Lemma 8 floor is sign-symmetric, and it is attained with equality by every nontrivial cycle of the shortcut Z map. The congruence holds over Z (two_pow_mul_iter_add_one_int): a consecutive odd states force x = -1 mod 2^a. On the positive side x + 1 >= 2^a gives Hercher's x >= 2^a - 1; on the negative side x <= -2 gives x + 1 <= -1, hence x + 1 <= -2^a and x <= -(2^a + 1). The negative floor is the LARGER of the two by exactly 2, and the negative side is the one that has cycles, so the valuation is not what separates the signs; the linear form is, 2^K - 3^o > 0 small forcing K enormous while 3^o - 2^K > 0 is 1 at K = 3 and 139 at K = 11. TIGHT AT ALL THREE. {1,2} has a = 1 and x = 1 = 2^1 - 1; -5 has a = 2 and |x| = 5 = 2^2 + 1; -17 has a = 4 and |x| = 17 = 2^4 + 1. Equivalently x + 1 = -2^a exactly at both negative cycles, equivalently -- through the cycle equation (x+1)(2^K - 3^o) = evenCharge w -- the odd part of the word's even-charge is |2^K - 3^o|: 1 for OOE and 139 for the -17 word. A bound tight at every object it is meant to exclude is not the exclusion, which is why Steiner-type results need Baker on top of Lemma 8 rather than Lemma 8 alone. -1 is the degenerate case the hypothesis x <= -2 removes, with u = 0 and the product formula vacuous. Paired with the kernel-checked neg_cycle_finance the floor becomes a per-word window 2^a + 1 <= |x| <= 1 + e 3^o / (2 (3^o - 2^K)), which at OOE is [5, 11/2] and so pins -5 as the unique realization of that word with no search.

Knight's cancellation transports to the Juggler exactly, and its residual is precisely the state dependence of the slack -- so the method dies at the Terras/FD wall and nowhere else. KNIGHT'S THREE PARTS. (i) Two members of one cycle, since Cohn makes the reverse of an aperiodic upper Christoffel word a rotation of it. (ii) An ADDITIVE cocycle: the Bohm-Sontacchi charge g is a function of the WORD alone, so the split v_h = 1u0, v_h^R = 0u1 gives g(v_h) = 2g(u) + 3^(x-1) and g(v_h^R) = 6g(u) + 2^(k-1), and 3f(v_h) - f(v_h^R) + 1 cancels the shared g(u). (iii) The leftover 2^(k-1)/(2^k - 3^x) is not an integer because the gap is odd. THE TRANSPORT. Part (i) is free, Cohn being a fact about words, so v_h and v_h^R are one Juggler cycle read at two points. Part (ii) transports formally through the kernel-checked multiplicative cocycle J-normalized-relative-slack, 1 + q_(uv) = (1+q_u)^(3^(#O(v))) (1+q_v)^(2^|u|): expanding w = O u E from n and w' = E u O from n' gives 1+q_w = (1+q_O @ n)^(3^p) (1+q_u @ J(n))^2 (1+q_E @ t)^(2^(m+1)) and 1+q_w' = (1+q_E @ n')^(3^(p+1)) (1+q_u @ J(n'))^6 (1+q_O @ t')^(2^(m+1)), so the multiplicative analogue of 3f - f^R is cube-and-divide, which cancels the shared middle exponent exactly, 3*2 - 6 = 0. THE RESIDUAL IS THE WHOLE STORY: (1+q_w)^3/(1+q_w') = [endpoint terms] * ((1+q_u @ J(n))/(1+q_u @ J(n')))^6. For Collatz the corresponding residual is identically 1, g(u) being literally the same integer in both expressions; for the Juggler 1 + q is a function of the word AND the state, the middle word being read at J(n) along one rotation and J(n') along the other, so the residual is a sixth power of their ratio. VERIFIED with exact rationals: the residual identity holds on all 15 word-pairs at length 6 taken at least starts, and on all 1354 instances obtained by pairing every realizing start below 6000 with the mirror's least start; the two middle slacks coincide in NONE of them. So Knight's method transports and fails at exactly the dichotomy J-juggler-is-collatz-one-exponential-up names: Collatz's word data is arithmetic and free (Terras), the Juggler's is state-dependent and open (Hypothesis FD). The same wall, met in a new place, which is the value of the row -- it says the obstruction is not incidental to this method. WHAT IT LEAVES, SCOPED. On a return 1 + q = n^(3^o - 2^L), so the left side is (n^3/n')^G with G the gap: a perfect G-th power, and Knight's parity step becomes a Catalan-flavoured condition. Hence a Juggler cycle carrying the Christoffel word AND having equal middle slacks at its two reverse-conjugate readings would force an explicit product of endpoint slacks to be a perfect G-th power. That equality is a strong Diophantine coincidence, is not conjectured here either way, and without it there is no exclusion. NO JUGGLER CYCLE IS EXCLUDED, no floor is raised, N_0 is unchanged and Paper A is untouched. This does not reopen J-cycle-near-tight-monochrome or J-affine-n-gap-escapes-dominance, both REFUTED in this neighbourhood; it is a different combination and it claims less.

What the Juggler's missing pointwise floor would buy, measured on the mirror side where it exists. The window of J-lemma-eight-floor-is-tight-at-every-known-cycle is empty exactly when 2^(a+1) theta_J > e with theta_J = 1 - 2^K / 3^o, so a negative cycle word obeys a <= log2(e / theta_J) - 1: the pointwise logarithmic odd-run bound the 19 September entry names as the Juggler's door, available here. On the 198891 expanding prefix-noncontracting words of length at most 22 it excludes 84.7 per cent and empties the lengths 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 13 and 16. THAT FIGURE FLATTERS IT. Paper A Theorem 3.31's census bound e >= 8 with 3^o > 2^K forces o >= 14 and hence K >= 22, so the census bound alone already excludes every shape word shorter than 22 and the two criteria can only be compared from there. At K = 22: 93222 shape words, 17637 admissible to e >= 8, of which the window kills 4787 -- 27.1 per cent. Every word it kills has leading run at least 6 and every survivor has leading run at most 5, so the floor's content at that length is precisely a cap of 5 on the leading odd run. AND IT GOES SLACK WHERE THE FRONTIER IS. The cap is log2(e / theta_J) - 1 and theta_J is the record near-convergent defect, so along the laboratory's leftover lengths it reads 8.02 at L = 19, 12.86 at 84, 16.59 at 569 and 22.09 at 1054, against 2.17 at L = 3 and 5 at L = 22. The leftovers are by definition where theta_J is a record minimum, hence exactly where this sieve permits the longest runs, while a word there needs only a short leading run to pass. So the door, priced where it is open, delivers the cycle starting line and stops before the first leftover -- sharper than the earlier argument that it would deliver 'at most Collatz's cycle starting line'. No Juggler cycle is excluded, no floor is raised, and no negative Collatz cycle is newly excluded: the laboratory's rational-cycle census already settled every length to 24 by exhibiting the cycles. What is new is that the exclusion is a criterion rather than a census, and the number attached to the door.
